### What is happening
The forecast for PRAMS & STROLLERS is **PHP 564.3M against a PHP 658.0M budget** for F27 H1. That is **PHP 93.8M, or 14.2%, short**, and the department's strategy is Growth. The forecast is also 9.6% below last year.

- **Trading so far:** in the 6 closed weeks, actual sales are PHP 132.7M. That is only 0.9% below forecast but 15.1% below budget. The forecast is predicting demand correctly; the budget is set too high.
- **Buy position:** the department is overbought, with 12.4 weeks of cover (stock plus on order) against a 7.7-week target and open-to-buy of PHP -111.7M. The excess sits in TRAVEL SYSTEM and DOUBLE STROLLER.
- **Exceptions flagged:** Bugaboo Australia's late purchase orders, plus overbuy in TRAVEL SYSTEM and DOUBLE STROLLER.

### What we tested
| Hypothesis | Evidence | Verdict |
|---|---|---|
| Budget set above demand | Actuals -0.9% to forecast, -15.1% to budget | **Confirmed** |
| Volume rather than price | Units -13.1%, price -1.3%; volume is 92.1% of the gap | **Confirmed** |
| One class dragging the rest | All 5 classes between -13.3% and -15.4% | Ruled out (all behind evenly) |
| One month or half | Months -14.2% to -14.3%; both halves about -14% | Ruled out (all behind evenly) |
| Late supplier POs | CAPSULE STROLLER (Bugaboo's class) -13.3% vs -14.4% for the rest | Ruled out |
| Overbought buy | Overbought classes -14.9% vs balanced -13.8% | Ruled out |
| Margin rate | Rate down only 0.31 points; 95.9% of the GP gap comes from lower sales | Ruled out |



### Impact
- **Sales:** PHP -93.8M (-14.2%) against budget.
- **Gross profit:** PHP 244.2M forecast against PHP 286.8M budget, a PHP -42.6M gap. Almost all of it comes from the lower sales, not a weaker margin rate.
- **H2 (Jul–Dec 2026):** the same gap repeats at -14.3%.
- **Stock:** demand is lower than planned while TRAVEL SYSTEM and DOUBLE STROLLER are overbought, so the risk of having to mark down excess stock is rising.

### Recommended actions
1. **Finance and Planning:** re-forecast the F27 budget to the demand-based forecast. This is a budget conversation, not a trading fix.
2. **Buying:** cut open orders in TRAVEL SYSTEM (17.1 weeks of cover against a 6.1-week target) and DOUBLE STROLLER (20.7 against 9.6).
3. **Merchandising:** protect gross profit on the lower sales base in H2, for example by asking the Plan Builder to "Find PHP 2M of GP in H2 for SINGLE STROLLER".
